test_name: Custom clef registration hook: anchor, size, gutter (set 005 s2)
description: A registered 1x2 rectangle path clef with anchor-semitones 16, height-semitones 8, and cnb:clef-gutter-semitones 4, on the default sps-2 staff with the default treble context (middleCPosition -6). The set-009 anchor contract puts the glyph TOP edge at semitone 16 = +2 staff-spaces = the TOP staff line; height 8 semitones = 4 staff-spaces means the bottom edge lands exactly on the BOTTOM line. Path stencils harvest real outline geometry (unlike the dozenal text anchors), so the bbox is asserted directly against the harvested staff geometry. The gutter is asserted via the first notehead's distance from the clef's right edge, per LilyPond version, because the two versions space the same 2-staff-space gutter differently (measured 2026-10-31, session 9, against an identical render without the gutter setting): on 2.24 the no-gutter distance is 7.617 and the gutter makes it 9.117 (+1.5); on 2.26 it is 7.704 and the gutter makes it 9.704 (the full +2.0). The clef itself sits at x = 3.645 on both. Baseline re-measured 2026-07-09 (set 007 s2): removing the vector model restored the documented 2-semitone default notehead by baking the former 0.75 scaling into cnb:notehead-shape-path, so the 2.24 absolute x values returned to 13.262 without the gutter and 14.762 with it.

assertions.description: The registered custom clef is engraved in measure 1

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: THE ANCHOR CONTRACT (TOP EDGE AT SEMITONE 16) ===

assertions.description: Glyph TOP edge lands on the top staff line (anchor semitone 16 at sps-2, treble mcp -6) and the bottom edge on the bottom line (height 8 semitones = the full 4-space staff)

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: SEMITONE-DENOMINATED SIZE AND UNIFORM SCALE ===

assertions.description: height-semitones 8 at sps-2 renders exactly 4 staff-spaces tall
The 1x2 path scales uniformly: height 4 staff-spaces implies width 2

assertions._comment: === SECTION 4: GUTTER PADDING PUSHES THE MUSIC RIGHT ===

assertions.description: First notehead sits 9.117 (2.24) / 9.704 (2.26) right of the clef's right edge: the no-gutter distance (7.617 / 7.704) plus the 4-semitone gutter's spacing contribution (+1.5 / +2.0)

assertions._comment: === SECTION 5: THE REST OF THE SCORE IS UNAFFECTED ===

assertions.description: Noteheads render normally alongside the custom clef
